outputs.explanation: Panel A shows photographs (bright-field and ICG fluorescence images of lungs), not a plot of averaged data.
Bar graph of mean ICG fluorescence intensity displays individual data points as colored dots (blue for No Cre, red for Adeno Cre) overlaid on the bars.

Panel C consists of micrograph/histology images (H&E, ICG, RNAscope) and spatial transcriptomic heatmap-style plots showing per-spot gene expression, not a summary plot of averaged data requiring individual points.
GSEA enrichment plots are line plots, which are exempt from requiring individual data point overlays.
Bar graph showing log2 fold change of M2/TAM genes displays only bars with p-values annotated; no individual data points are overlaid to show underlying variability.
Panel F shows fluorescence and IHC micrograph/photograph images, not a plot of averaged data.
